title: Interactive Shell Capability — Stateful Execution with Brokered Command Authorization
description: Extends the CapabilityBroker to authorize and manage stateful interactive shell sessions (SSH, reverse shells, pseudo-TTYs). Introduces dual-gate authorization (session + per-command), command filtering pipeline, and TTY output ingestion into EvidenceGraph/WorldModel.

required: D-Series (Cognitive Architecture): Arena, Planner, CapabilityBroker, SafetyVerifier, Evaluator, WorldModel, EvidenceGraph
forbidden_modifications: CapabilityBroker public interface (only extension via register_capability)

architecture.overview: Interactive shells are stateful, long-lived capabilities. Unlike stateless probes (HTTP, banner grabs), a shell session maintains a persistent connection with bidirectional I/O. The architecture introduces: (1) InteractiveShellCapability — wrapper around pwntools/paramiko/sshlib; (2) ShellSession — brokered state object tracked by CapabilityBroker; (3) CommandFilterPipeline — static allowlist + LLM intent classifier; (4) TTYNormalizer — converts raw ANSI/terminal output to structured Evidence.

interface.connect: Establish connection (SSH, reverse shell, bind shell, meterpreter). Returns ShellSession.
interface.send_command: Send a single command string; returns raw output (stdout+stderr) and exit code.
interface.send_raw: Send raw bytes (for interactive prompts, Ctrl-C, etc.).
